This R Markdown file reproduces all analyses, tables, and figures of the manuscript, in their order of appearance, followed by the appendix material.

**Inputs (not included in the repository; see `data/README.md`):** the FONASA diagnosis-related group (DRG) discharge database, the 2014 Ministry of Health (MINSAL) length-of-stay reference standard, the FONASA DRG master tables, and the population estimates and projections of the Chilean National Statistics Institute (INE). All files are read from the `data/` folder.

**Outputs:** `figures/` (Figures 1–3 and Figure S1) and `tables/` (`Tables_main.docx` with Tables 1–3 and `Appendix_tables.docx` with Tables S1–S7).

```{r lancet_helpers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
## Lancet-style number formatting -----------------------------------------
# Mid-dot decimal point (0·75); thin space only in numbers with 5 or more digits (30 286)
lancet_num <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  gsub(".", "\u00B7", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits), fixed = TRUE)
}

lancet_int <- function(x) {
  ifelse(abs(x) >= 10000,
         formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = "\u2009"),
         formatC(x, format = "d"))
}

# p values with two significant figures, at most four decimals, or p<0·0001
lancet_p <- function(p) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p)   ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.0001 ~ "<0.0001",
    p < 0.001  ~ formatC(round(p, 4), format = "f", digits = 4),
    TRUE       ~ formatC(signif(p, 2), format = "fg", digits = 2, flag = "#")
  )
  gsub(".", "\u00B7", out, fixed = TRUE)
}

lancet_ci <- function(est, lo, hi, digits = 2) {
  sprintf("%s (%s\u2013%s)", lancet_num(est, digits), lancet_num(lo, digits), lancet_num(hi, digits))
}

n_pct <- function(x, n, digits = 1) {
  sprintf("%s (%s%%)", lancet_int(x), lancet_num(100 * x / n, digits))
}

# Wilson 95% CI for proportions
wilson_ci <- function(x, n, z = qnorm(0.975)) {
  p      <- x / n
  centre <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  half   <- z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  list(lo = centre - half, hi = centre + half)
}

# "p=0·12" or "p<0·0001", as appropriate
p_text <- function(p) {
  x <- lancet_p(p)
  ifelse(startsWith(x, "<"), paste0("p", x), paste0("p=", x))
}

# Median (IQR), used in Tables 1 and S4 and in the text
iqr_fmt <- function(x) {
  q <- round(quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE))
  sprintf("%s (%s\u2013%s)", q[2], q[1], q[3])
}
```

# Data and study population

```{r data_import, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
read_rds_safe <- function(filename) {
  path <- here::here("data", filename)
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  readRDS(path)
}

read_excel_safe <- function(filename, sheet) {
  path <- here::here("data", filename)
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = TRUE)
}

raw_data <- read_rds_safe("consolidated_data_COPD.rds")
minsal_df <- read_excel_safe("Norma MINSAL 2014_definitivo.xlsx", sheet = "PC IRGRD incluidos")

flow_log <- tibble::tibble(
  step        = "Initial database",
  excluded_n  = NA_integer_,
  remaining_n = nrow(raw_data)
)

apply_filter_step <- function(data, condition, step_label, flow_log_object) {
  filtered_data <- data %>% dplyr::filter({{ condition }})
  new_row <- tibble::tibble(
    step        = step_label,
    excluded_n  = nrow(data) - nrow(filtered_data),
    remaining_n = nrow(filtered_data)
  )
  list(
    data     = filtered_data,
    flow_log = dplyr::bind_rows(flow_log_object, new_row)
  )
}

# --- STEP 1: Study period (2019-2024) ---
tmp <- apply_filter_step(
  raw_data,
  fecha_ingreso_dt >= lubridate::ymd("2019-01-01") &
    fecha_ingreso_dt <= lubridate::ymd("2024-12-31"),
  "Excluded outside study period (2019-2024)",
  flow_log
)
filtered_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

# --- STEP 2: Adults only ---
tmp <- apply_filter_step(
  filtered_data,
  age >= 40,
  "Excluded age < 40 years",
  flow_log
)
filtered_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

# --- STEP 3: Unknown province or sex ---
tmp <- apply_filter_step(
  filtered_data,
  PROVINCIA != "DESCONOCIDO" & SEXO != "DESCONOCIDO",
  "Excluded unknown province or sex",
  flow_log
)
filtered_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

rates_data <- filtered_data   # base for population rates (before the insurance and length-of-stay filters)

# --- STEP 4: Valid admission type ---
# tmp <- apply_filter_step(
#   filtered_data,
#   TIPO_INGRESO %in% c("URGENCIA", "PROGRAMADA"),
#   "Excluded admission types other than emergency or scheduled",
#   flow_log
# )
# filtered_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

# --- STEP 5: Valid discharge type ---
# tmp <- apply_filter_step(
#   filtered_data,
#   TIPOALTA != "NO IDENTIFICADA",
#   "Excluded unknown discharge type",
#   flow_log
# )
# filtered_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

# --- STEP 6: Keep only FONASA beneficiaries (A, B, C, D) ---
tmp <- apply_filter_step(
  filtered_data,
  PREVISION %in% c(
    "FONASA INSTITUCIONAL - (MAI) A",
    "FONASA INSTITUCIONAL - (MAI) B",
    "FONASA INSTITUCIONAL - (MAI) C",
    "FONASA INSTITUCIONAL - (MAI) D"
  ),
  "Excluded non-FONASA insurance categories",
  flow_log
)
filtered_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

# --- MINSAL cutoffs ---
norma_minsal_cortes <- minsal_df %>%
  dplyr::select(COD_GRD = 1, EM_norma = 8, PC_inf = 17, PC_sup = 18) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    COD_GRD  = stringr::str_pad(as.character(COD_GRD), width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    EM_norma = as.numeric(EM_norma),
    PC_inf   = as.numeric(PC_inf),
    PC_sup   = as.numeric(PC_sup)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(COD_GRD))

data_con_limites <- filtered_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(IR_29301_COD_GRD = stringr::str_pad(
    as.character(IR_29301_COD_GRD), width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(norma_minsal_cortes, by = c("IR_29301_COD_GRD" = "COD_GRD"))

df_inliers <- data_con_limites %>%  dplyr::filter(    !is.na(PC_inf), !is.na(PC_sup),    days_total_hospitalization >= PC_inf,    days_total_hospitalization <= PC_sup  )

df_outliers <- data_con_limites %>%  dplyr::filter(    !is.na(PC_inf), !is.na(PC_sup),    days_total_hospitalization < PC_inf |      days_total_hospitalization > PC_sup  ) 

df_unclassified <- data_con_limites %>%  dplyr::filter(is.na(PC_inf) | is.na(PC_sup)) 

# --- STEP 7a: DRG without MINSAL reference ---
tmp <- apply_filter_step(
  data_con_limites,
  !is.na(PC_inf) & !is.na(PC_sup),
  "Excluded DRG without MINSAL 2014 reference",
  flow_log
)
filtered_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

# Breakdown of outliers (for the flow diagram and the mortality check)
n_low  <- sum(filtered_data$days_total_hospitalization <  filtered_data$PC_inf, na.rm = TRUE)
n_high <- sum(filtered_data$days_total_hospitalization >  filtered_data$PC_sup, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- STEP 7b: LOS within MINSAL limits ---
tmp <- apply_filter_step(
  filtered_data,
  days_total_hospitalization >= PC_inf & days_total_hospitalization <= PC_sup,
  "Excluded LOS outside MINSAL 2014 limits",
  flow_log
)
copd_data <- tmp$data; flow_log <- tmp$flow_log

# --- STEP 8: Dichotomise admission type ---
copd_data <- copd_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TIPO_INGRESO = dplyr::if_else(TIPO_INGRESO == "URGENCIA",
                                              "URGENCIA", "PROGRAMADA"))
```

```{r mortality_sensitivity, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mort_sens <- data_con_limites %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC_inf), !is.na(PC_sup)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = if_else(
      days_total_hospitalization >= PC_inf & days_total_hospitalization <= PC_sup,
      "Inliers (analytic dataset)", "LOS outliers"
    ),
    death = TIPOALTA == "FALLECIDO"
  )

bind_rows(
  mort_sens %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(episodes = n(), deaths = sum(death), .groups = "drop"),
  mort_sens %>%
    summarise(group = "All episodes (inliers + outliers)",
              episodes = n(), deaths = sum(death))
) %>%
  mutate(mortality_pct = round(100 * deaths / episodes, 1))
```

## Figure 1: study flow diagram

```{r flow_diagram, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fmt <- function(x) lancet_int(x)

excl <- flow_log[-1, ]
stopifnot(nrow(excl) == 6)
stopifnot(n_low == 0)   # the LOS label assumes no exclusions below the lower limit

excl_labels <- c(
  "admission outside 2019\u20132024",
  "age <40 years",
  "unknown sex or province",
  "insurance other than FONASA tiers A\u2013D",
  "DRG without MINSAL 2014 LOS reference",
  "LOS above MINSAL 2014 upper limit"
)

k   <- nrow(excl)
pts <- paste0("p", seq_len(k))
exn <- paste0("e", seq_len(k))

n_pat_ini <- if ("UID_patient" %in% names(raw_data)) data.table::uniqueN(raw_data$UID_patient) else NA
n_pat_fin <- data.table::uniqueN(copd_data$UID_patient)

lab_A <- sprintf("COPD episodes, FONASA DRG discharge database\\n(ICD-10 J44.0, J44.1, J44.8, J44.9)\\n%s episodes%s",
                 fmt(nrow(raw_data)),
                 if (!is.na(n_pat_ini)) sprintf("; %s patients", fmt(n_pat_ini)) else "")
lab_Z <- sprintf("Final analytic dataset\\n%s episodes; %s patients",
                 fmt(nrow(copd_data)), fmt(n_pat_fin))

flow_txt <- paste0("
digraph flowchart {
  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB, nodesep = 0.4, ranksep = 0.15, bgcolor = white]
  node  [fontname = Helvetica, fontsize = 9, shape = rectangle, penwidth = 0.8, color = black]
  edge  [color = gray30, arrowsize = 0.6, penwidth = 0.8, arrowhead = none]

  A [label = '", lab_A, "', width = 3.2, height = 0.7]
  Z [label = '", lab_Z, "', width = 3.2, height = 0.6, penwidth = 1.2]
",
  paste0(pts, " [shape = point, width = 0.01, height = 0.01, label = '']", collapse = "\n"), "\n",
  paste0(sprintf("%s [label = 'Excluded: %s\\nn = %s', width = 3.0, height = 0.45, color = gray40]",
                 exn, excl_labels, fmt(excl$excluded_n)), collapse = "\n"), "\n",
  paste(c("A", pts), collapse = " -> "), "\n",
  pts[k], " -> Z [arrowhead = normal]\n",
  paste0(pts, " -> ", exn, " [arrowhead = normal]", collapse = "\n"), "\n",
  paste0("{rank = same; ", pts, "; ", exn, "}", collapse = "\n"),
"\n}")

flow_plot <- DiagrammeR::grViz(flow_txt)
flow_plot

# Export at 180 mm width and 300 dpi (= 2126 px), as for Figures 2 and 3
svg_txt <- DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(flow_plot)

# Check: natural SVG size and effective font size once scaled to 180 mm
svg_w_pt <- as.numeric(sub(".*?width=\"([0-9.]+)pt\".*", "\\1", svg_txt))
svg_h_pt <- as.numeric(sub(".*?height=\"([0-9.]+)pt\".*", "\\1", svg_txt))
scale    <- (180 / 25.4 * 72) / svg_w_pt
cat(sprintf("Effective font size: %.1f pt | final height: %.0f mm\n",
            9 * scale, svg_h_pt * scale * 25.4 / 72))

dir.create(here::here("figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
out_png <- here::here("figures", "Figure_1.png")
rsvg::rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg_txt), out_png, width = 2126)

# Declare 300 dpi in the file (rsvg does not write it)
img <- magick::image_read(out_png)
magick::image_write(img, out_png, format = "png", density = "300x300")
```

# Derived variables

## Comorbidity indices

```{r comorb_prep, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fmt_n <- function(x) lancet_int(x)
fmt_p <- function(x) lancet_num(x, 1)

# Avoid duplicated columns (.x/.y) if the chunk is run more than once
copd_data <- copd_data %>%
  select(-any_of(c("episode_id", "death", "charlson_score", "cci_group",
                   "elixhauser_score", "elixhauser_n", "elixhauser_n_nocopd",
                   "elix_group"))) %>%
  mutate(
    episode_id = row_number(),
    death      = TIPOALTA == "FALLECIDO"
  )

## 1. Diagnoses in long format (principal + secondary) ------------------
icd_cols <- intersect(paste0("CODIGO", 1:35), names(copd_data))

diag_long <- copd_data %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  select(episode_id, all_of(icd_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(icd_cols), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(icd_cols), names_to = "position", values_to = "code",
               values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(code = str_remove_all(toupper(code), "[^A-Z0-9]")) %>%   # "J44.1" -> "J441"
  filter(code != "") %>%
  transmute(id = episode_id, code) %>%
  distinct()

stopifnot(n_distinct(diag_long$id) == nrow(copd_data))

## 2. Charlson (Quan ICD-10, pesos Quan) ----------------------------------
cci_map <- comorbidity::comorbidity(
  x = as.data.frame(diag_long), id = "id", code = "code",
  map = "charlson_icd10_quan", assign0 = TRUE
)

cci_df <- tibble::as_tibble(cci_map) %>%
  mutate(
    charlson_score = as.numeric(comorbidity::score(cci_map, weights = "quan", assign0 = TRUE)),
    cci_group = cut(charlson_score, breaks = c(-Inf, 2, 4, Inf),
                    labels = c("Low (0\u20132)", "Intermediate (3\u20134)", "High (>4)"))
  )

## 3. Elixhauser (Quan ICD-10, pesos van Walraven) ------------------------
elix_map <- comorbidity::comorbidity(
  x = as.data.frame(diag_long), id = "id", code = "code",
  map = "elixhauser_icd10_quan", assign0 = TRUE
)
elix_cols <- setdiff(names(elix_map), "id")

elix_df <- tibble::as_tibble(elix_map) %>%
  mutate(
    elixhauser_score    = as.numeric(comorbidity::score(elix_map, weights = "vw", assign0 = TRUE)),
    elixhauser_n        = rowSums(across(all_of(elix_cols))),   # 0/1 indicators only
    elixhauser_n_nocopd = elixhauser_n - cpd,                   # excluding COPD
    elix_group = cut(elixhauser_n_nocopd, breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 2, 4, Inf),
                     labels = c("0", "1\u20132", "3\u20134", "\u22655"))
  )

## 4. Checks: all episodes should have 'cpd' = 1 --------------------------
cat("Episodes without COPD detected (Charlson):",   sum(cci_df$cpd  == 0), "\n")
cat("Episodes without COPD detected (Elixhauser):", sum(elix_df$cpd == 0), "\n")

## 5. Unir a copd_data ------------------------------------------------------
copd_data <- copd_data %>%
  left_join(cci_df %>% select(episode_id = id, charlson_score, cci_group),
            by = "episode_id") %>%
  left_join(elix_df %>% select(episode_id = id, elixhauser_score,
                               elixhauser_n, elixhauser_n_nocopd, elix_group),
            by = "episode_id")
```

```{r comorb_functions, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Top N comorbidities (excluding COPD) with mortality and Fisher's exact test
comorb_mortality <- function(comorb_df, labels, outcome_df,
                             exclude = "cpd", top_n = 10) {
  vars <- intersect(setdiff(names(labels), exclude), names(comorb_df))
  d <- outcome_df %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    select(id = episode_id, death) %>%
    inner_join(comorb_df %>% select(id, all_of(vars)), by = "id")

  purrr::map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
    x   <- d[[v]] == 1
    tbl <- table(factor(x, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
                 factor(d$death, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))
    tibble(
      Comorbidity  = unname(labels[v]),
      N            = sum(x),
      Prevalence   = 100 * mean(x),
      Mort_with    = 100 * mean(d$death[x]),
      Mort_without = 100 * mean(d$death[!x]),
      p_value      = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(desc(N)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
}

# Paper-style table (same format as Table 1)
comorb_flextable <- function(tab, caption, n_total) {
  tab %>%
    transmute(
      Comorbidity  = paste0(Comorbidity, if_else(p_value < 0.05, "*", "")),
      N            = fmt_n(N),
      Prevalence   = fmt_p(Prevalence),
      Mort_with    = fmt_p(Mort_with),
      Mort_without = fmt_p(Mort_without),
      p            = lancet_p(p_value)
    ) %>%
    flextable::flextable() %>%
    flextable::set_header_labels(
      Comorbidity  = "Comorbidity",
      N            = "N",
      Prevalence   = "Prevalence (%)",
      Mort_with    = "Mortality with (%)",
      Mort_without = "Mortality without (%)",
      p            = "p-value"
    ) %>%
    flextable::theme_booktabs() %>%
    flextable::bold(part = "header") %>%
    flextable::align(j = 2:6, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    flextable::font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
    flextable::set_caption(caption) %>%
    flextable::add_footer_lines(paste0(
      "Data from ", fmt_n(n_total), " COPD hospitalisation episodes, Chilean FONASA/GRD system (2019\u20132024). ",
      "Prevalence: episodes with the condition over all episodes. ",
      "Mortality with/without: in-hospital mortality among episodes with/without the condition. ",
      "Analyses were conducted at the episode level; patients may contribute more than one episode. ",
      "Chronic pulmonary disease (COPD) is not listed because it was present in all episodes. ",
      "*p<0\u00B705 (Fisher's exact test)."
    )) %>%
    flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") %>%
    flextable::autofit()
}

# Support for the text: significant conditions and absolute mortality differences
describe_table <- function(tab) {
  cat("Significant (p < 0.05):", sum(tab$p_value < 0.05), "of", nrow(tab), "\n")
  tab %>%
    mutate(diff = round(Mort_with - Mort_without, 1)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(diff))) %>%
    select(Comorbidity, Mort_with, Mort_without, diff, p_value) %>%
    print()
}
```

```{r procedures_prep, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## 1. Procedure columns (ICD-9-CM) ----------------------------------------
# ADJUST the pattern if your columns are named differently
proc_cols <- grep("^PROC_CODIGO\\d+$", names(copd_data), value = TRUE)
if (length(proc_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No procedure columns found: adjust the proc_cols pattern")
}
cat("Procedure columns found:", length(proc_cols), "\n")

## 2. Long format, codes without dot ("93.96" -> "9396") -----------------
proc_long <- copd_data %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  select(episode_id, all_of(proc_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(proc_cols), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(proc_cols), values_to = "code", values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(code = str_remove_all(toupper(code), "[^A-Z0-9]")) %>%
  filter(code != "") %>%
  distinct(episode_id, code)

# Check: the 15 most frequent codes (9396, 9921, 9923... should appear)
proc_long %>% count(code, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 15) %>% print()

## 3. Procedure definitions -------------------------------------------------
proc_defs <- list(
  oxygen   = "9396",                             # Oxygen enrichment
  iv_abx   = "9921",                             # Injection of antibiotic
  iv_ster  = "9923",                             # Injection of steroid
  iv_other = "9929",                             # Other therapeutic infusion
  niv      = "9390",                             # Non-invasive mechanical ventilation
  imv      = c("9604", "9670", "9671", "9672")   # Intubation / invasive MV
)

proc_labels <- c(
  oxygen   = "Oxygen therapy (93.96)",
  iv_abx   = "Intravenous antibiotics (99.21)",
  iv_ster  = "Intravenous corticosteroids (99.23)",
  iv_other = "Other therapeutic infusion (99.29)",
  niv      = "Non-invasive ventilation (93.90)",
  imv      = "Invasive mechanical ventilation (96.04, 96.70\u201396.72)"
)

## 4. Episode-level indicators (idempotent) --------------------------------
proc_indicator_cols <- paste0("proc_", names(proc_defs))

copd_data <- copd_data %>%
  select(-any_of(proc_indicator_cols))

for (nm in names(proc_defs)) {
  ids <- unique(proc_long$episode_id[proc_long$code %in% proc_defs[[nm]]])

  copd_data <- copd_data %>%
    mutate(!!paste0("proc_", nm) := episode_id %in% ids)
}

copd_data %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(proc_indicator_cols),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  print()
```

```{r table_1_tier, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Each episode appears in its tier and in the Total column

## 2. Row builders -----------------------------------------------------------
wide <- function(d) d %>% pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = cell)

row_median <- function(var, label) {
  t1_all %>%
    group_by(col) %>%
    summarise(cell = iqr_fmt(.data[[var]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    wide() %>%
    mutate(Characteristic = label, type = "header")
}

row_binary <- function(var, label, type = "item") {
  t1_all %>%
    group_by(col) %>%
    summarise(cell = n_pct(sum(.data[[var]]), n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
    wide() %>%
    mutate(Characteristic = label, type = type)
}

block_cat <- function(var, levels, title) {
  body <- t1_all %>%
    mutate(level = factor(.data[[var]], levels = levels)) %>%
    count(col, level, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(col) %>%
    mutate(cell = n_pct(n, sum(n))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(col, level, cell) %>%
    wide() %>%
    transmute(Characteristic = as.character(level), across(all_of(t1_cols)), type = "item")
  bind_rows(tibble(Characteristic = title, type = "header"), body)
}
```

```{r mortality_models, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## 0. DRG relative weight variable: ADJUST if named differently --------------
weight_var <- "IR_29301_PESO"
if (!weight_var %in% names(copd_data)) {
  stop(weight_var, " not found. Variables containing 'PESO': ",
       paste(grep("PESO", names(copd_data), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "))

# Convert text with decimal comma or point to numeric
to_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  as.numeric(str_replace(str_trim(as.character(x)), ",", "."))
}

## 1. Model data --------------------------------------------------------------
model_data <- copd_data %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    death            = as.integer(death),
    imv              = as.integer(proc_imv),
    niv              = as.integer(proc_niv),
    oxygen           = as.integer(proc_oxygen),
    age,
    female           = as.integer(SEXO == "MUJER"),   # reference: men
    charlson_score,
    elixhauser_score,
    rw               = to_num(.data[[weight_var]]),
    UID_patient
  )

# Missing values by variable BEFORE dropping rows
na_by_var <- sapply(model_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
print(na_by_var)

n_before   <- nrow(model_data)
model_data <- model_data %>% tidyr::drop_na()
n_lost     <- n_before - nrow(model_data)

if (n_lost > 0.05 * n_before) {
  stop(n_lost, " of ", n_before,
       " episodes lost owing to missing values. Check the variables with NA above.")
}

cat("Episodes in models:", nrow(model_data), "| excluded for missing data:", n_lost, "\n")
cat("Deaths:", sum(model_data$death), "\n")
cat("SD age:", round(sd(model_data$age), 1), "years",
    "| SD relative weight:", round(sd(model_data$rw), 3), "\n")

model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    age_z = as.numeric(scale(age)),
    rw_z  = as.numeric(scale(rw))
  )

## 2. Logistic regression with patient-clustered robust SEs -----------------
fit_or <- function(formula, data) {
  fit <- glm(formula, data = data, family = binomial)
  vc  <- sandwich::vcovCL(fit, cluster = data$UID_patient)
  ct  <- lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = vc)
  auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(data$death, fitted(fit), quiet = TRUE))

  list(
    fit = fit,
    auc = auc,
    tab = tibble(
      term    = rownames(ct),
      OR      = exp(ct[, 1]),
      lo      = exp(ct[, 1] - 1.96 * ct[, 2]),
      hi      = exp(ct[, 1] + 1.96 * ct[, 2]),
      p_value = ct[, 4]
    ) %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)")
  )
}

## 3. Modelos ---------------------------------------------------------------
m_cci  <- fit_or(death ~ imv + niv + oxygen + age_z + female + charlson_score   + rw_z, model_data)
m_elix <- fit_or(death ~ imv + niv + oxygen + age_z + female + elixhauser_score + rw_z, model_data)
m_norw <- fit_or(death ~ imv + niv + oxygen + age_z + female + charlson_score,          model_data)

cat("\nAUC CCI model:", round(m_cci$auc, 3),
    "| AUC Elixhauser model:", round(m_elix$auc, 3),
    "| AUC CCI model without relative weight:", round(m_norw$auc, 3), "\n\n")

cat("CCI model\n");                                         print(m_cci$tab)
cat("\nElixhauser model\n");                                print(m_elix$tab)
cat("\nSensitivity: CCI model without relative weight\n");  print(m_norw$tab)

p_fmt  <- function(p) lancet_p(p)
or_fmt <- function(or, lo, hi) lancet_ci(or, lo, hi, 2)

fmt_model <- function(tab, prefix) {
  tab %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      !!paste0(prefix, "_or") := or_fmt(OR, lo, hi),

table_s2 <- tibble(term = names(labels_s2), Variable = unname(labels_s2)) %>%
```

## Figure 2: cumulative incidence of in-hospital death

```{r cif_prep}

  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(

    status   = factor(if_else(death, "death", "discharge"),

p95_los <- as.numeric(quantile(cif_data$los, 0.95))
cat("P95 LOS:", p95_los, "days\n")
```

```{r cif_functions}
## Cumulative incidence of death (Aalen–Johansen), discharge alive as competing event
cif_analysis <- function(var, t_max = p95_los) {
  d   <- cif_data %>% mutate(grp = .data[[var]])
  fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(los, status) ~ grp, data = d)
  j   <- which(fit$states == "death")
  s   <- summary(fit, times = 0:t_max, extend = TRUE)

  curve <- tibble(
    group  = factor(str_remove(as.character(s$strata), "^grp="), levels = levels(d$grp)),
    time   = s$time,
    cif    = s$pstate[, j],
    lo     = s$lower[, j],
    hi     = s$upper[, j],
    n_risk = s$n.risk[, 1]
  )

  # Gray's test (fstatus: 0 = censored, 1 = discharged alive, 2 = death)
  gray <- cmprsk::cuminc(ftime = d$los, fstatus = as.integer(d$status) - 1L,
                         group = d$grp, cencode = 0)
  
  # p value computed directly from the upper tail
  gray_stat <- unname(gray$Tests["2", "stat"])
  gray_df   <- unname(gray$Tests["2", "df"])

  gray_p <- stats::pchisq(
    gray_stat,
    df = gray_df,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  list(
    curve  = curve,
    p_gray    = gray_p,
    gray_stat = gray_stat,
    gray_df   = gray_df,
    crude  = d %>%
      group_by(group = grp) %>%
      summarise(episodes = n(), deaths = sum(status == "death"),
                crude_mortality = round(100 * deaths / episodes, 1), .groups = "drop")
  )
}

## Support table for the text: day 15 and P95
cif_table <- function(res, at = c(15, p95_los)) {
  res$curve %>%
    filter(time %in% at) %>%
    mutate(across(c(cif, lo, hi), ~ round(100 * .x, 1))) %>%
    select(group, time, cif, lo, hi, n_risk)
}

format_gray_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("p unavailable")
  if (p < 0.0001) return("p<0\u00b70001")

  value <- if (p < 0.001) {
    sprintf("%.4f", p)
  } else {
    sprintf("%.3f", p)
  }

  paste0("p=", sub(".", "\u00b7", value, fixed = TRUE))
}

## Returns both parts (curves + risk table) to align them in a single patchwork
plot_cif_parts <- function(res, panel, y_max, t_max = p95_los) {
  curve <- res$curve %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(time_end = lead(time, default = max(time))) %>%
    ungroup()

  greys <- c("black", "grey40", "grey65")[seq_len(nlevels(curve$group))]
  p_lab <- paste("Gray's test", format_gray_p(res$p_gray))

  main <- ggplot(curve, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = time, xmax = time_end, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_step(aes(y = cif, colour = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = t_max, y = y_max * 0.97, label = p_lab,
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = greys) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = greys) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, t_max, 5), limits = c(0, t_max)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       breaks = seq(0, y_max, by = 0.05),
                       limits = c(0, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = panel, x = "Days since admission",
         y = "Cumulative incidence\nof in-hospital death",
         colour = NULL, fill = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, hjust = 0.02),
      plot.title.position  = "plot",
      axis.title           = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y         = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = 10, unit = "pt")
      ),
      axis.text            = element_text(colour = "black"),
      legend.position      = c(0.02, 0.97),
      legend.justification = c(0, 1),
      legend.background    = element_rect(
        fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      legend.key.height    = unit(3.5, "mm"),
      plot.margin          = margin(t = 8, r = 4, b = 0, l = 4)
    )

  risk <- ggplot(curve %>% filter(time %in% seq(0, t_max, by = 5)),
                 aes(x = time, y = forcats::fct_rev(group),
                     label = fmt_n(as.integer(n_risk)))) +
    geom_text(size = 2.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, t_max, 5), limits = c(0, t_max)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(subtitle = "Number at risk", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(panel.grid    = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x   = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8),
          plot.margin   = margin(t = 2, r = 4, b = 4, l = 4))

  list(main = main, risk = risk)
}
```

## Figure 3: provincial hospitalisation rates

```{r rates_prep}
## 0. Rate numerator ------------------------------------------------------------
#  TRUE (recommended): all COPD discharges aged >=40 years, 2019-2024, with known
#   province and sex, without exclusions by insurance or length-of-stay outliers.
# FALSE: analytic dataset only (copd_data).
use_all_episodes <- TRUE
rates_source <- if (use_all_episodes) rates_data else copd_data

years   <- 2019:2024
norm_nm <- function(x) str_squish(toupper(stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")))

## 1. INE population aged >=40 years by province and year --------------------
ine <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "estimaciones-y-proyecciones-2002-2035-comunas.xlsx"))

needed <- c("Provincia", "Nombre Provincia", "Edad", paste("Poblacion", years))
if (!all(needed %in% names(ine))) {
  stop("Missing columns in the INE file: ",
       paste(setdiff(needed, names(ine)), collapse = ", "))
}

pop_40 <- ine %>%
  filter(as.numeric(Edad) >= 40) %>%
  select(Provincia, `Nombre Provincia`, all_of(paste("Poblacion", years))) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("Poblacion"), names_to = "year",
               names_prefix = "Poblacion ", values_to = "population") %>%
  mutate(
    year             = as.integer(year),
    codigo_provincia = sprintf("%03d", as.integer(Provincia)),
    provincia_norm   = norm_nm(`Nombre Provincia`)
  ) %>%
  group_by(codigo_provincia, provincia_norm, province = `Nombre Provincia`, year) %>%
  summarise(population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(distinct(pop_40, codigo_provincia, provincia_norm)$codigo_provincia)))

pop_prov <- pop_40 %>%
  group_by(codigo_provincia, provincia_norm, province) %>%
  summarise(person_years = sum(population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pop_mean = person_years / length(years))

cat("Provinces in INE file:", nrow(pop_prov), "\n")

## 2. Cases by province (derived from municipality of residence) -------------
fix_prov <- function(x) case_when(
  x == "BIO-BIO"   ~ "BIOBIO",
  x == "AISEN"     ~ "AYSEN",
  x == "COIHAIQUE" ~ "COYHAIQUE",
  TRUE ~ x
)

fix_comuna <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace_all(x, '"', "'")          # O"HIGGINS -> O'HIGGINS
  case_when(
    x == "COIHAIQUE" ~ "COYHAIQUE",
    x == "CON CON"   ~ "CONCON",
    x == "AISEN"     ~ "AYSEN",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# Municipality -> province according to INE (same file as the denominator)
comuna_lookup <- ine %>%
  distinct(`Nombre Comuna`, Provincia) %>%
  transmute(
    comuna_norm      = norm_nm(`Nombre Comuna`),
    codigo_provincia = sprintf("%03d", as.integer(Provincia))
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(pop_prov %>% select(codigo_provincia, prov_from_comuna = provincia_norm),
            by = "codigo_provincia")

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(comuna_lookup$comuna_norm)))

cases <- rates_source %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    year          = lubridate::year(fecha_ingreso_dt),
    comuna_norm   = fix_comuna(norm_nm(COMUNA)),
    prov_declared = fix_prov(norm_nm(PROVINCIA))
  ) %>%
  left_join(comuna_lookup %>% select(comuna_norm, prov_from_comuna), by = "comuna_norm") %>%
  mutate(
    # Province from municipality; if the municipality does not match, PROVINCIA is used
    provincia_norm = coalesce(prov_from_comuna, prov_declared)
  )

cat("Episodes assigned by COMUNA:", sum(!is.na(cases$prov_from_comuna)),
    "| by PROVINCIA (comuna not matched):", sum(is.na(cases$prov_from_comuna)), "\n")

# Check: allocation of episodes with the former province "NUBLE"
cat("Former 'NUBLE' episodes by assigned province:\n")
cases %>% filter(prov_declared == "NUBLE") %>% count(provincia_norm) %>% print()

stopifnot(all(cases$year %in% years))

unmatched <- setdiff(unique(cases$provincia_norm), pop_prov$provincia_norm)
if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  stop("Provinces without a match in the INE file: ",
       paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "), ". Add them to fix_prov() or fix_comuna().")
}

cases_prov <- cases %>% count(provincia_norm, name = "cases")

## 3. Rates by province (from the population: provinces without cases = 0) ---
add_rate <- function(d, cases_col = "cases", py_col = "person_years") {
  x  <- d[[cases_col]]
  py <- d[[py_col]]
  d %>%
    mutate(
      rate = 1e5 * x / py,
      lo   = 1e5 * qchisq(0.025, 2 * x) / 2 / py,
      hi   = 1e5 * qchisq(0.975, 2 * (x + 1)) / 2 / py
    )
}

zone_of <- function(reg) {
  factor(case_when(
    reg %in% c("15", "01", "02", "03", "04") ~ "North",
    reg %in% c("05", "13", "06", "07", "16") ~ "Centre",
    reg %in% c("08", "09", "14", "10")       ~ "South",
    reg %in% c("11", "12")                   ~ "Austral"
  ), levels = c("North", "Centre", "South", "Austral"))
}

rates_prov <- pop_prov %>%
  left_join(cases_prov, by = "provincia_norm") %>%
  mutate(
    cases         = coalesce(cases, 0L),
    codigo_region = substr(codigo_provincia, 1, 2),
    zone          = zone_of(codigo_region)
  ) %>%
  add_rate() %>%
  arrange(desc(rate))

stopifnot(sum(rates_prov$cases) == nrow(cases), !anyNA(rates_prov$zone))

cat("Episodes used for rates:", nrow(cases), "\n")
cat("Provinces with zero episodes:",
    paste(rates_prov$province[rates_prov$cases == 0], collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

rates_prov %>%
  transmute(province, zone, cases, pop_mean = round(pop_mean),
            across(c(rate, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

santiago_n <- rates_prov$cases[rates_prov$province == "Santiago"]
cat("Santiago:", santiago_n, "episodes (",
    lancet_num(100 * santiago_n / nrow(cases), 1), "% of", nrow(cases), ")\n")
```

```{r map_layers}
# STEP 5.5: Add province numbers and identify high incidence provinces
# Province number = order in rates_prov (decreasing rate), as in Table S6

# STEP 6: Helper function for NUMBER labels (replaces text labels)
make_number_labels <- function(sf_obj) {
  # Compute centroids for number placement
  centroids <- sf::st_point_on_surface(sf::st_geometry(sf_obj))
  coords <- sf::st_coordinates(centroids)
  
  sf_obj %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(
      lab_x = coords[, 1],
      lab_y = coords[, 2]
    )
}

# Generate number label positions
labels_norte_num   <- make_number_labels(mapa_norte)
labels_centro_num  <- make_number_labels(mapa_centro)
labels_sur_num     <- make_number_labels(mapa_sur)
labels_austral_num <- make_number_labels(mapa_austral)


# Number label layer

number_label_layer <- function(label_df) {
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = label_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = provincia_num),
    size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "black", fill = "white",
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.1, "lines"), label.size = 0.2,
    box.padding = 0.15, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1
  )
}


# Optional: Add province NAMES only for high incidence areas (top 10)
high_incidence_label_layer <- function(label_df) {
  high_inc <- label_df %>% filter(is_high_incidence == TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(high_inc) > 0) {
    ggplot2::geom_label(  # Changed from geom_text to geom_label
      data = high_inc,
      ggplot2::aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = nombre_corto),
      size = 3.0,
      color = "black",
      fontface = "bold",
      fill = "white",  # White background
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.15, "lines"),
      label.size = 0.3,
      alpha = 0.9
    )
  } else {
    geom_blank()  # Return empty layer if no high incidence provinces
  }
}

# STEP 7: Create maps with NUMBERS

  )
)

make_zone_map <- function(zone_sf, label_df, xlim, ylim, title, tag) {
  label_df <- label_df %>%
    filter(between(lab_x, xlim[1], xlim[2]), between(lab_y, ylim[1], ylim[2]))
  
  suppressWarnings(
    ggplot(zone_sf) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = avg_incidence_rate), colour = "gray28", linewidth = 0.2) +
      number_label_layer(label_df) +
      coord_sf(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE, clip = "on") +
      fill_scale +
      labs(subtitle = title, tag = tag) +
      theme_void(base_size = 8, base_family = "sans") +
      theme(
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
        plot.tag          = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
        plot.margin       = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
      )
  )
}
```

```{r figure_3_map, fig.width=7.09, fig.height=8.86}
# STEP 8: Create zone-specific legend tables
# Province tables by macrozone
zone_table_theme <- gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
  base_size = 7,
  padding = grid::unit(c(1.0, 0.6), "mm"),
  core = list(
    fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.04),
    bg_params = list(fill = c("white", "grey95"))
  ),
  colhead = list(
    fg_params = list(
      fontface = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      x = 0.04
    ),
    bg_params = list(fill = "grey80")
  )
)

create_zone_table <- function(mapa_zone, n_cols = 1, x_offset_mm = 0) {

  zl <- mapa_zone %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(nombre_provincia)) %>%
    arrange(nombre_provincia) %>%
    transmute(
      `#` = provincia_num,
      Province = nombre_provincia
    )

  # Split the province list into adjacent table blocks
  block_size <- ceiling(nrow(zl) / n_cols)

  blocks <- split(
    zl,
    ceiling(seq_len(nrow(zl)) / block_size)
  )

  # Pad shorter blocks to keep table heights consistent
  blocks <- lapply(blocks, function(x) {
    x[] <- lapply(x, as.character)

    if (nrow(x) < block_size) {
      blank_rows <- x[
        rep(NA_integer_, block_size - nrow(x)),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      blank_rows[] <- ""
      x <- rbind(x, blank_rows)
    }

    x
  })

  grobs <- lapply(
    blocks,
    gridExtra::tableGrob,
    rows = NULL,
    theme = zone_table_theme
  )

    # 4 mm space between adjacent blocks
  if (length(grobs) > 1) {
    grobs[-length(grobs)] <- lapply(grobs[-length(grobs)], gtable::gtable_add_cols,
                                    widths = grid::unit(4, "mm"))
  }

  tab <- if (length(grobs) == 1) grobs[[1]] else do.call(gridExtra::gtable_cbind, grobs)

  # Apply an optional horizontal offset without changing table dimensions
  aligned_table <- grid::grobTree(
    tab,
    vp = grid::viewport(
      x = grid::unit(x_offset_mm, "mm"),
      y = 0.5,
      width = grid::grobWidth(tab),
      height = grid::grobHeight(tab),
      just = c("left", "centre")
    )
  )

  out <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = aligned_table, clip = FALSE) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

  # Actual table width, to allocate exactly that space in the panel
  attr(out, "width_mm") <- grid::convertWidth(sum(tab$widths), "mm", valueOnly = TRUE) + x_offset_mm
  out
}

table_norte <- create_zone_table(mapa_norte)

# Shift only the Centre table to the right
table_centro <- create_zone_table(mapa_centro)

table_sur <- create_zone_table(mapa_sur)

table_austral <- create_zone_table(mapa_austral)

# Keep map margins small
map_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "pt")
)

# Map (flexible width) + fixed space + table (exact width)
make_panel <- function(map, tab, gap_mm = 3) {
  (map + map_theme) + plot_spacer() + tab +
    plot_layout(widths = grid::unit(c(1, gap_mm, attr(tab, "width_mm")),
                                    c("null", "mm", "mm")))
}

panel_norte   <- make_panel(p_norte,   table_norte)
panel_centro  <- make_panel(p_centro,  table_centro)
panel_sur     <- make_panel(p_sur,     table_sur)
panel_austral <- make_panel(p_austral, table_austral)

# Leave an empty column and row between macrozone panels
layout_design <- "
A#B
###
C#D
"

p_fig3 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  A = panel_norte,
  B = panel_centro,
  C = panel_sur,
  D = panel_austral,
  design = layout_design,
  widths = grid::unit(
    c(1, 5, 1),
    c("null", "mm", "null")
  ),
  heights = grid::unit(
    c(1, 6, 1),
    c("null", "mm", "null")
  ),
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 3, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(2, "mm"),
    #plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 8, unit = "pt")
  )

p_fig3

  plot = p_fig3,
```

## Table S2: quantile regression of length of stay

```{r los_quantreg, cache=TRUE, cache.extra=rlang::hash(los_year[c("los", "year", "sex", "UID_patient")])}
## Quantile regression with jittering (Machado & Santos Silva, 2005)
## and patient-clustered bootstrap

qr_data <- los_year %>%
  mutate(
    year = relevel(factor(year), ref = "2019"),
    sex  = relevel(factor(sex),  ref = "Women")
  )

X <- model.matrix(~ year + sex, data = qr_data)
y <- qr_data$los
idx_by_patient <- split(seq_len(nrow(qr_data)), qr_data$UID_patient)

# One fit with LOS + U(0,1)
fit_jitter <- function(rows, tau) {
  y_j <- y[rows] + runif(length(rows))
  quantreg::rq.fit(X[rows, , drop = FALSE], y_j, tau = tau, method = "fn")$coefficients
}

taus <- c(0.50, 0.75, 0.90)
J    <- 20    # jitters for the point estimate
B    <- 200   # patient-level bootstrap replicates
set.seed(2024)

qr_results <- purrr::map_dfr(taus, function(tt) {
  est <- rowMeans(replicate(J, fit_jitter(seq_len(nrow(X)), tt)))

  boot <- replicate(B, {
    pats <- sample(length(idx_by_patient), replace = TRUE)
    fit_jitter(unlist(idx_by_patient[pats], use.names = FALSE), tt)
  })
  se <- apply(boot, 1, sd)

  tibble(
    tau      = tt,
    term     = colnames(X),
    estimate = est,
    se       = se,
    lo       = est - 1.96 * se,
    hi       = est + 1.96 * se,
    p_value  = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se))
  )
})

print(qr_results, n = Inf)

# Wide table: one column per quantile
r1 <- function(x) lancet_num(round(x, 2) + 0, 2)   # avoids "-0.00"

qr_table <- qr_results %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = term %>%
      str_replace("^year(\\d{4})$", "Year \\1 (vs. 2019)") %>%
      str_replace("^sexMen$", "Men (vs. women)"),
    cell = paste0(r1(estimate), " (", r1(lo), " to ", r1(hi), ")",
                  if_else(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05, "*", ""))
  ) %>%
  select(term, tau, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tau, values_from = cell)

qr_table %>%
  flextable::flextable() %>%
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    term = "Variable",
    `0.5` = "\u03C4 = 0.50", `0.75` = "\u03C4 = 0.75", `0.9` = "\u03C4 = 0.90"
  ) %>%
  flextable::theme_booktabs() %>%
  flextable::bold(part = "header") %>%
  flextable::align(j = 2:4, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  flextable::font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  flextable::set_caption("Table S2: Quantile regression of length of stay (days) by calendar year and sex in COPD hospitalisation episodes, Chile, 2019\u20132024") %>%
  flextable::add_footer_lines(paste(
    "Coefficients are absolute differences in days at each quantile of LOS (95% CI).",
    "Reference categories: 2019 and women.",
    "LOS was jittered with uniform U(0,1) noise to account for its discrete nature (estimates averaged over 20 jitters).",
    "95% CIs from patient-clustered bootstrap (200 replicates). *p < 0.05."
  )) %>%
  flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") %>%
  flextable::autofit() -> ft_S2
ft_S2
```

```{r table_4_procedures, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
iqr_fmt <- function(x) {
  q <- round(quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE))
  sprintf("%s (%s\u2013%s)", q[2], q[1], q[3])
}

n_total <- nrow(copd_data)

table4 <- purrr::map_dfr(names(proc_labels), function(nm) {
  d <- copd_data %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(flag = .data[[paste0("proc_", nm)]],
              death,
              los  = days_total_hospitalization)

  grp <- d %>%
    group_by(flag) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), deaths = sum(death), los_txt = iqr_fmt(los), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(flag))                                  # TRUE (with) first

  bind_rows(
    tibble(Group = proc_labels[[nm]], N = "", Mortality = "", LOS = "", type = "header"),
    tibble(
      Group     = c("With", "Without"),
      N         = sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt_n(grp$n), fmt_p(100 * grp$n / n_total)),
      Mortality = sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt_n(grp$deaths), fmt_p(100 * grp$deaths / grp$n)),
      LOS       = grp$los_txt,
      type      = "item"
    )
  )
})
```

```{r fonasa_models, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
## 1. Data (same variables as model_data + tier) ------------------------------
model_data_tier <- copd_data %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    death            = as.integer(death),
    imv              = as.integer(proc_imv),
    niv              = as.integer(proc_niv),
    oxygen           = as.integer(proc_oxygen),
    age,
    female           = as.integer(SEXO == "MUJER"),
    charlson_score,
    elixhauser_score,
    rw               = to_num(.data[[weight_var]]),
    tier_num         = as.integer(tier),           # A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4 (tendencia)
    tier             = relevel(tier, ref = "D"),   ## reference: tier D (highest income)
    UID_patient
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    age_z = as.numeric(scale(age)),
    rw_z  = as.numeric(scale(rw))
  )

# Must match the main model (same episodes and same standardisation)
# tier  = relevel(tier, ref = "D"),   
# reference: tier D (highest income)
stopifnot(nrow(model_data_tier) == nrow(model_data))

## 2. Joint Wald test with patient-clustered robust variance -----------------
wald_joint <- function(fit, cluster, pattern = "^tier[A-D]$") {
  vc   <- sandwich::vcovCL(fit, cluster = cluster)
  idx  <- grep(pattern, names(coef(fit)))
  b    <- coef(fit)[idx]
  V    <- vc[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
  stat <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% solve(V, b))
  pchisq(stat, df = length(idx), lower.tail = FALSE)
}

fit_tier <- function(rhs) {
  add     <- if (rhs == "") "" else paste("+", rhs)
  m_cat   <- fit_or(as.formula(paste("death ~ tier", add)),     model_data_tier)
  m_trend <- fit_or(as.formula(paste("death ~ tier_num", add)), model_data_tier)
  list(
    cat     = m_cat,
    p_joint = wald_joint(m_cat$fit, model_data_tier$UID_patient),
    p_trend = m_trend$tab$p_value[m_trend$tab$term == "tier_num"]
  )
}

## 3. Modelos ---------------------------------------------------------------
specs <- list(
  crude     = "",
  age_sex   = "age_z + female",
  full_cci  = "imv + niv + oxygen + age_z + female + charlson_score + rw_z",
  full_elix = "imv + niv + oxygen + age_z + female + elixhauser_score + rw_z"
)

tier_models <- purrr::map(specs, fit_tier)

cat("AUC by model:\n")
print(round(sapply(tier_models, function(x) x$cat$auc), 3))
cat("AUC main CCI model without tier:", round(m_cci$auc, 3), "\n\n")

cat("Fully adjusted CCI model with tier (all covariates):\n")
print(tier_models$full_cci$cat$tab)

## 4. Table of ORs by tier -----------------------------------------------------
tier_or <- tibble(term = paste0("tier", LETTERS[1:4]),
                  Tier = paste("FONASA", LETTERS[1:4]))

for (nm in names(tier_models)) {
  tier_or <- tier_or %>%
    left_join(
      tier_models[[nm]]$cat$tab %>%
        filter(str_detect(term, "^tier[A-D]$")) %>%
        transmute(term, !!nm := lancet_ci(OR, lo, hi)),
      by = "term"
    )
}

tier_or <- tier_or %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(names(specs)), ~ coalesce(.x, "1 (ref)")))

p_rows <- tibble(
  term = c("p_joint", "p_trend"),
  Tier = c("p value (joint Wald test)", "p value for trend")
)
for (nm in names(tier_models)) {
  p_rows[[nm]] <- c(lancet_p(tier_models[[nm]]$p_joint), lancet_p(tier_models[[nm]]$p_trend))
}

tier_or_tab <- bind_rows(tier_or, p_rows) %>% select(-term)
print(tier_or_tab)

tier_or_tab %>%
  flextable::flextable() %>%
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Tier      = "",
    crude     = "Unadjusted OR (95% CI)",
    age_sex   = "Age-adjusted and sex-adjusted OR (95% CI)",
    full_cci  = "Fully adjusted OR (95% CI), Charlson",
    full_elix = "Fully adjusted OR (95% CI), Elixhauser"
  ) %>%
  flextable::theme_booktabs() %>%
  flextable::bold(part = "header") %>%
  flextable::align(j = 2:5, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  flextable::font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  flextable::set_caption("Table S5: Association between FONASA tier and in-hospital death in COPD hospitalisation episodes, Chile, 2019\u20132024") %>%
  flextable::add_footer_lines(paste0(
    "Logistic regression on ", lancet_int(nrow(model_data_tier)), " episodes from ",
    lancet_int(n_distinct(model_data_tier$UID_patient)), " patients (",
    lancet_int(sum(model_data_tier$death)), " deaths), with robust standard errors clustered by patient. ",
    "Reference: tier D (highest income). Fully adjusted models include age (per 1 SD), sex, invasive mechanical ventilation, ",
    "non-invasive ventilation, oxygen therapy, DRG relative weight (per 1 SD), and the Charlson Comorbidity Index score ",
    "or the Elixhauser van Walraven score. The joint Wald test assesses any difference between tiers; ",
    "the test for trend enters tier as an ordinal score (A=1 to D=4). DRG=diagnosis-related group. OR=odds ratio."
  )) %>%
  flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") %>%
  flextable::autofit() -> ft_S5
ft_S5
```

```{r table_s7_rates_network, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Annual national rate: all hospitals vs stable network ----------------------
hosp_cases <- rates_source %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%

n_years_total <- n_distinct(hosp_cases$year)

stable_hosp <- hosp_cases %>%
  distinct(COD_HOSPITAL, year) %>%
  count(COD_HOSPITAL, name = "n_years") %>%
  filter(n_years == n_years_total) %>%
  pull(COD_HOSPITAL)

n_hosp_year <- hosp_cases %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(hospitals = as.character(n_distinct(COD_HOSPITAL)), .groups = "drop")

rates_compare <- bind_rows(
  hosp_cases %>% mutate(network = "all"),
  hosp_cases %>% filter(COD_HOSPITAL %in% stable_hosp) %>% mutate(network = "stable")
) %>%
  count(network, year, name = "cases") %>%
  left_join(pop_year, by = "year") %>%
  add_rate() %>%
  group_by(network) %>%
  mutate(change = 100 * (rate / rate[year == 2019] - 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Typographic minus sign (\u2212) for negative changes
fmt_change <- function(x) sub("^-", "\u2212", lancet_num(x, 1))

table_s7 <- rates_compare %>%
  transmute(
    year, network,
    cases  = lancet_int(cases),
    rate   = lancet_ci(rate, lo, hi, 1),

  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = network, values_from = c(cases, rate, change)) %>%
  left_join(n_hosp_year, by = "year") %>%
  transmute(
```

```{r export_tables, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
appendix_tables <- list(ft_S1, ft_S2, ft_S3, ft_S4, ft_S5, ft_S6, ft_S7)

flextable::save_as_docx(values = main_tables,
                        path = here::here("tables", "Tables_main.docx"),
                        pr_section = landscape)
flextable::save_as_docx(values = appendix_tables,
                        path = here::here("tables", "Appendix_tables.docx"),
                        pr_section = landscape)

cat("Tables exported to:", here::here("tables"), "\n")
```

# Data quality checks

```{r check_residence}
## 0. Support tables -----------------------------------------------------------
fix_prov <- function(x) case_when(
  x == "BIO-BIO"   ~ "BIOBIO",
  x == "AISEN"     ~ "AYSEN",
  x == "COIHAIQUE" ~ "COYHAIQUE",
  TRUE ~ x
)

# Path to the hospital master file
master_file <- here::here(
  "data",
  "Tablas maestras bases GRD .xlsx"
)

# Confirm that the file exists
stopifnot(file.exists(master_file))

# Import hospital names
hosp_names <- readxl::read_excel(
  path = master_file,
  sheet = "Hospitales",
  skip = 1,
  col_names = c("COD_HOSPITAL", "hospital")
) %>%
  mutate(COD_HOSPITAL = as.character(COD_HOSPITAL))

# Municipality -> province according to INE (same file as the denominator)
comuna_lookup <- ine %>%
  distinct(`Nombre Comuna`, Provincia) %>%
  transmute(
    comuna_norm      = norm_nm(`Nombre Comuna`),
    codigo_provincia = sprintf("%03d", as.integer(Provincia))
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(pop_prov %>% select(codigo_provincia, prov_from_comuna = provincia_norm),
            by = "codigo_provincia")

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(comuna_lookup$comuna_norm)))

fix_comuna <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace_all(x, '"', "'")          # O"HIGGINS -> O'HIGGINS
  case_when(
    x == "COIHAIQUE" ~ "COYHAIQUE",
    x == "CON CON"   ~ "CONCON",
    x == "AISEN"     ~ "AYSEN",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

chk <- rates_data %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    COD_HOSPITAL,
    comuna_norm   = fix_comuna(norm_nm(COMUNA)),
    prov_declared = fix_prov(norm_nm(PROVINCIA))
  ) %>%
  left_join(comuna_lookup %>% select(comuna_norm, prov_from_comuna), by = "comuna_norm")

## Check 1: patients by hospital ----------------------------------------------
by_hosp <- chk %>%
  group_by(COD_HOSPITAL) %>%
  summarise(
    episodes       = n(),
    n_comunas      = n_distinct(comuna_norm),
    n_provinces    = n_distinct(prov_declared),
    top_prov_share = round(max(table(prov_declared)) / n(), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(hosp_names, by = "COD_HOSPITAL") %>%
  arrange(desc(episodes))

cat("Hospitals:", nrow(by_hosp),
    "| without name in master table:", sum(is.na(by_hosp$hospital)), "\n")
cat("Hospitals with patients from a single province:", sum(by_hosp$n_provinces == 1), "\n\n")
print(by_hosp %>% select(hospital, episodes, n_comunas, n_provinces, top_prov_share),
      n = 20)

## Check 2: declared province vs province derived from municipality ---------
unmatched_com <- chk %>% filter(is.na(prov_from_comuna)) %>% count(comuna_norm, sort = TRUE)
cat("\nEpisodes whose COMUNA is not found in the INE file:", sum(unmatched_com$n), "\n")
print(unmatched_com, n = 30)

matched <- chk %>% filter(!is.na(prov_from_comuna), prov_declared != "NUBLE")
cat("\nAgreement PROVINCIA vs province derived from COMUNA:",
    round(100 * mean(matched$prov_declared == matched$prov_from_comuna), 1), "%\n")

matched %>%
  filter(prov_declared != prov_from_comuna) %>%
  count(prov_declared, prov_from_comuna, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = 20)

## "NUBLE" episodes: which province does their municipality belong to? -------
cat("\nFormer 'NUBLE' episodes by province derived from COMUNA:\n")
chk %>%
  filter(prov_declared == "NUBLE") %>%
  count(prov_from_comuna, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print()
```
```{r check_hospitals, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Hospitals reporting COPD episodes by year ---------------------------------
hosp_year <- copd_data %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    year         = lubridate::year(fecha_ingreso_dt),
    COD_HOSPITAL = as.character(COD_HOSPITAL)
  )

## 1. Number of hospitals and episodes by year
hosp_year %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    hospitals = n_distinct(COD_HOSPITAL),
    episodes  = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("Hospitals with at least one episode in 2019-2024:",
    n_distinct(hosp_year$COD_HOSPITAL), "\n")

## 2. Hospitals present in all years vs only some
presence <- hosp_year %>%
  distinct(COD_HOSPITAL, year) %>%
  group_by(COD_HOSPITAL) %>%
  summarise(
    n_years    = n(),
    first_year = min(year),
    last_year  = max(year),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

presence %>% count(n_years, name = "hospitals") %>% print()

## 3. Hospitals entering or leaving during the period
changes <- presence %>%
  filter(n_years < 6) %>%
  left_join(
    hosp_year %>% count(COD_HOSPITAL, name = "episodes"),
    by = "COD_HOSPITAL"
  ) %>%
  arrange(first_year, desc(episodes))

## 4. Hospital names, if hosp_names exists (chunk check_residence)
if (exists("hosp_names")) {
  changes <- changes %>% left_join(hosp_names, by = "COD_HOSPITAL")
}
print(changes, n = Inf)

## 5. Share of those hospitals in the total number of episodes
cat("Episodes in hospitals not present in all years:",
    sum(changes$episodes), "of", nrow(hosp_year),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * sum(changes$episodes) / nrow(hosp_year)))
```
```{r rates_stable_network, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Annual national rate restricted to hospitals reporting in all 6 years -------
hosp_cases <- rates_source %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    year         = lubridate::year(fecha_ingreso_dt),
    COD_HOSPITAL = as.character(COD_HOSPITAL)
  )

# Must match the rate numerator
stopifnot(nrow(hosp_cases) == nrow(cases))

stable_hosp <- hosp_cases %>%
  distinct(COD_HOSPITAL, year) %>%
  count(COD_HOSPITAL, name = "n_years") %>%
  filter(n_years == 6) %>%
  pull(COD_HOSPITAL)

cat("Hospitals reporting in all 6 years (rates numerator):", length(stable_hosp), "\n")

rates_compare <- bind_rows(
  hosp_cases %>% mutate(network = "All hospitals"),
  hosp_cases %>% filter(COD_HOSPITAL %in% stable_hosp) %>% mutate(network = "Stable network")
) %>%
  count(network, year, name = "cases") %>%
  left_join(pop_year, by = "year") %>%
  add_rate() %>%
  group_by(network) %>%
  mutate(change_vs_2019 = 100 * (rate / rate[year == 2019] - 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

rates_compare %>%
  mutate(
    rate_ci        = lancet_ci(rate, lo, hi, 1),
    change_vs_2019 = lancet_num(change_vs_2019, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(network, year, cases, rate_ci, change_vs_2019) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
